evaluation_target.rationale: The safety goal explicitly states that the system shall prevent unintended braking, and the hazard describes the adverse event as the vehicle suddenly stopping without an obstacle in front.

phenomenon_of_interest.statement: The vehicle braking behavior in the stated operational situation, including whether braking occurs and whether it is justified by an obstacle or collision-avoidance need.
phenomenon_of_interest.scope: Straight ahead driving on a less frequented urban road at 50 km/h, in good weather, with no visible obstacles or vehicles in front of the ego vehicle.
phenomenon_of_interest.rationale: The hazard defines the operational situation and the hazardous event. The phenomenon must cover braking behavior within that situation so the safety goal can be evaluated.

distinctions.dimension: Presence of an obstacle or collision-relevant object ahead of the vehicle
distinctions.contrast_a: A situation in which an obstacle is present in front of the ego vehicle and braking may be required to avoid collision
distinctions.contrast_b: A situation in which no obstacle is in front of the ego vehicle
distinctions.rationale: The hazardous event is specifically defined as stopping although no obstacle is in front of the vehicle, while FR-7 states that braking is to avoid collisions with obstacles. Collapsing these situations would lose the information needed to judge whether braking is intended or unintended.

orrs.obligation: An admissible Observable Representation shall preserve whether the observed driving situation contains an obstacle or other collision-relevant object in front of the vehicle.
orrs.distinguishability_criterion: Situations with an obstacle ahead and situations with no obstacle ahead must remain distinguishable in the representation.
